name: Multiboard planner
description: Plans a Multiboard wall: the layout, and every tile and mount to print it, from your own library.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: Grid tiles with offset snaps: corners, edges and core tiles, and every snap counted, single, dual or quad.
Single bordered tiles joined by dual clips, standing free, in the dark theme.
A wall measured in inches, with the strips that fill its edges and the space left over.

collection.name: Multiboard models
collection.description: The Multiboard joints the planner mounts a wall with -- the snaps, the clip, the pillar and the foot -- which come with the tool itself. Its plates aren't here: those are drawn when a wall asks for one. Multiboard is MultiBuild's design: see multibuild.io/license.
